title: Reading Drill — A Smarter Lost Property List
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Smarter Lost Property List
passages.body:
**A** At a sports hall, lost items were placed on a table with the date they were found. Most visitors remembered the colour or size of an item but not the date of their last visit.

**B** Staff introduced a form organised by type. They kept one feature of each item hidden from the public list so the person claiming it had to provide a description.

**C** After a trial, staff photographed large items only. This made the list easier to browse, while smaller objects could still be identified by asking about their contents.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Most visitors remembered the colour or size of an item but not the date of their last visit.
